output.explanation: NIG-AE invoiced AED 50,000.00 (NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031395, secondment of T. O'Connor, AE-ICINV-00555). output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should gross up the IC payable to AED 50,000 by recognising the AED 2,500 WHT as a liability to ZATCA, and give NIG-AE the WHT certificate so it can recognise the tax suffered.
output.adjustment_description: In NIG-SA, credit the IC payable to NIG-AE by AED 2,500 and debit the WHT payable/clearing account by AED 2,500 for withholding tax on AE-ICINV-00555. When settlement occurs, NIG-AE clears the AED 2,500 receivable against WHT suffered, once it holds the certificate.
